impact: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added four flaws impacting Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway, SAP NetWeaver, and Broadcom VMware vCenter to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), citing evidence of active exploitation. The addition of CVE-2026-76466 to the KEV catalog follows a report from F6 that the vulnerability was exploited to breach a Russian organization following the release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, enabling the attackers to move laterally across the network and access sensitive data. The exploitation of CVE-2026-123890, on the other hand, has linked to a suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group tracked as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221), which is said to have weaponized it in conjunction with another now-patched flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764, CVSS score: 9.3) to deploy custom backdoors for persistent access and data theft.
